Branch `bb/relay-271-review-debt-06-12-mirror-the-choke-poi-thr_3478kz9sas` pushed to origin.

## Summary

`deleteInboxTypeWithClient` (in `backend/packages/data/src/inbox/inboxTypesStore.ts`) called `itemsStore.softDeleteItem` directly and only re-implemented part of the choke-point's soft-delete contract (the delete heartbeat), missing:
- the `systemActive` guard (row-locked check preventing deletion of system-active items), and
- rollup recompute enqueueing for the item's relation edges.

Fix: extracted `softDeleteItemWithClient` out of `chokePoint.ts`'s `createChokePoint` closure as a standalone exported function, following the same pattern already used for `createItemWithClient`/`updateItemWithClient`/`deleteRelationWithClient`. It performs the full contract: lock + `systemActive` guard, soft delete, delete heartbeat, and rollup recompute enqueueing for all relation edges. Both `createChokePoint`'s `softDeleteItem` and `deleteInboxTypeWithClient` now call this shared function.

Verified: full monorepo build (`pnpm -r run build`, 7 packages) compiles clean, and the full backend test suite (24 files, 313 tests) passes.
